# Al Wafi Islamic Boarding School Landing Page

This is a React.js landing page project for Al Wafi Islamic Boarding School built with Vite and Tailwind CSS.

## Project Structure
- Modern, responsive React components
- Data fetched from `public/data.json`
- Tailwind CSS for styling via CDN
- Font Awesome icons for visual elements
- Component-based architecture

## Key Components
- Header: Navigation with mobile menu
- Hero: Main banner with call-to-action
- About: Vision, mission, and features
- Programs: Educational programs and overseas study
- Alumni: University achievements and statistics
- Contact: Campus locations and registration info
- Footer: Additional links and contact details

## Styling Guidelines
- Use Tailwind CSS utility classes
- Green (#10b981) as primary color
- Blue accents for variety
- Responsive design (mobile-first)
- Modern gradients and shadows
- Hover effects and transitions

## Data Management
- All content stored in `public/data.json`
- Images referenced by URL from original website
- Fallback placeholders for broken images
- Loading states for data fetching

## Best Practices
- Semantic HTML structure
- Accessible navigation
- SEO-friendly content
- Performance optimized
- Mobile responsive design
